days.title: 吉婆岛
days.morning: Travel Hanoi – Hai Phong, take the speedboat to the island and check in.
days.afternoon: Swim at Cat Co 1, 2 and 3 and walk the cliffside path.
days.evening: Sunset at Cannon Fort and seafood at the fishing pier.

days.title: 兰夏湾
days.morning: Sail to Lan Ha Bay and kayak through the Light and Dark caves.
days.afternoon: Swim at Ba Trai Dao beach and visit Cai Beo fishing village.
days.evening: Stroll the town's walking street and try crab noodle soup.

days.title: 国家公园
days.morning: Trek in Cat Ba National Park and climb Ngu Lam peak.
days.afternoon: Visit Hospital Cave and Trung Trang cave.
days.evening: Dinner on a floating raft with night views of the bay.

days.title: 猴岛 – 越海村
days.morning: Speedboat to Monkey Island and its white-sand beach.
days.afternoon: Cycle to Viet Hai village deep inside the national park.

days.title: 凤凰花之城海防
days.morning: Back to Hai Phong: the Opera House and Tam Bac old quarter.
days.afternoon: Tuong Long tower and Do Son beach.
days.evening: Hai Phong food tour: stick bánh mì, crab spring rolls, crab noodle soup.
